product_one_liner.value: Wellinks combines virtual chronic care management and remote patient monitoring to help people with COPD and other cardiopulmonary conditions receive personalized care and earlier clinical intervention.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable current opening is Senior Data and BI Analyst, which is excluded by the requested title criteria.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the public Knowledge Base, predictive-care pages, blog, privacy policy and HIPAA notice; no named AI model or model provider was disclosed. References to proprietary predictive algorithms and Spire analytics do not identify an underlying model or external provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Public HIPAA compliance claim, not an independent certification: the notice says it protects PHI in accordance with HIPAA. No completed SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR or PCI DSS claim was found.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 4, 2026 as the first close of the Series B, rather than necessarily the final round total.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 4, 2026 financing falls within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive opening appeared on the readable current board.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying product or major-feature launch was found for 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09. The integrated Predictive Patient Care offering was announced September 30, 2024; the reviewed 2026 news concerns financing and leadership, not a product launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On August 31, 2026, Wellinks announced Stephanie Solich as Vice President of Customer Success; the same announcement also reported two internal VP promotions.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy explicitly identifies these web-analytics systems; this is an analytics/marketing signal, not evidence of a CRM. No CRM was named in the reviewed live job posting.
